item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft, the weather over the coast of southern China will be mainly fine in the next few days. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Besides, the northeast monsoon will affect the coastal areas early next week. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region.

Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
